says: The tracker comment is passed as --body-file /dev/stdin to a Node child whose stdin is a socket, and Linux refuses to open /dev/stdin on a socket, so a comment made by land.ts merged fails on Linux; macOS allows it.
proof: In a Linux container on Node 26.13.0, a child spawned with a piped stdin that runs readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8') exits 1 with 'ENXIO: no such device or address, open /dev/stdin'; the same on macOS prints the text. The same cause turned three land.test.ts tests red in CI run 43540705745 through leakgrep.sh --text /dev/stdin.
cost: On a Linux machine, the queue's settle step cannot write its comment on a ticket; no test covers the real tracker call, so CI stays green.
